script_text:
Aquarius, this week shatters your routine: your air-element ruler, Uranus, could turn one bold conversation into a career opening.

Early on, Venus retrogrades through your 6th House, so a promising Thursday exchange could sour if you demand instant reassurance. You don’t need a dramatic declaration tonight. Friday favors honesty, not chasing mixed signals.

Midweek, Mars in your 6th House sextiles Uranus in your 3rd, sharpening interview presence and fresh ideas.

Late in the week, Saturday feels electric: your air-element ruler, Uranus, supports bolder career pitches and lively dates. Sunday settles into warmer conversation.

Saturday is your power day because that Mars–Uranus sextile makes you persuasive in job interviews and salary discussions.

Wednesday is your caution day because Mercury in your 8th nears opposition to Uranus in your 3rd, scrambling financial details.

Send proposals after a draft review, then follow up Sunday.

Follow for daily updates.
